description: Modified IEEE 33-Bus and 69-Bus Test Systems for paper "A Novel Approach for Asymmetric Volt/VAr Parameterization of Smart Inverters in Active Distribution Networks is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rafael Yuki de Souza Yamamoto, Rubén Romero (Universidade Estadual Paulista Júlio de Mesquita Filho - Câmpus de Rosana). This dataset contains the modified IEEE 33-node and 69-node radial distribution test systems utilized to evaluate the asymmetric Volt/VAr parameterization of smart inverters in active distribution networks. The standard topologies were structurally adapted to support mixed-integer second-order cone programming optimal power flow evaluations coupled with particle swarm optimization metaheuristics. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
